Sword Blox Online: Rebirth (SBO:R)

Enter a massive anime-inspired world of swords, danger, and progression.
Fight your way through a world of interconnected floors, grow stronger with every battle, and carve your own path to the top.

⚔️ GAMEPLAY

🌎 Explore 19 unique floors, each with unique enemies, quests, and challenges
💀 Defeat bosses and progress through increasingly dangerous zones
💪 Level up, upgrade your build, and unlock powerful skills
🛡️ Discover 2,000+ items, including weapons, armor, and rare gear

🌟 FEATURES

👥 Play solo or party with friends
🎨 Customize your character with builds, outfits, and playstyles
🔥 Experience live events and constant updates
📈 Deep progression system with long-term growth

🆕 LATEST UPDATES:
-> Waypoints
-> Boss Respawn Timers & Bulk Stat Invest
